items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued October 10 at 4:06PM EDT until October 10 at 8:00PM EDT by NWS Tampa Bay Ruskin FL
items.description:
* WHAT...Southwest winds around 20 to 25 knots with gusts up to
30 knots.

* WHERE...Coastal waters from Englewood to Tarpon Springs out to
60 NM including the Tampa Bay waters.

* WHEN...From 8 AM this morning to 8 PM EDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
